messages:
eva: finally finished decorating my WFH corner: string lights, three succulents, and a thrifted lamp. looks cosy but now i get a weird camera glare when the lights hit the monitor. photo attached 📸
omar: pics pls :eyes: we need inspiration for our home-office-themed sprint board
eva: uploading... (1 pic) 
ivanote: the glare is on the bottom-right corner of the webcam, almost like a ring reflection
zane: have you tried angling the lamp away from the monitor or moving the string lights behind screens? small reposition often fixes it
ivy: also try lowering the webcam exposure or use a little inline diffuser (a layer of tissue over the lamp, carefully)
lou: pro hack: get a small inexpensive hood for the webcam (3D print or tape a folded index card) to block stray light
eva: love the hood idea. quick poll: should i (1) move lamp, (2) add hood, (3) turn off lights during calls? vote with emoji 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣
omar: 2️⃣ - minimal change, keeps mood lighting
zane: 1️⃣ for now, 2️⃣ if glare persists
ivy: 2️⃣ and post before/after pic 📸
netbot: [automated] Reminder: home-office safety tip: ensure string lights are not resting on plants to avoid overheating. See health-safety guide: http://tiny.cc/wfh-safety
lou: also if you're getting webcam reflection you can try software correction: many webcam apps allow gamma/contrast tweak
eva: thanks all! i'll try the card-hood + dimmer. promise a follow-up pic later today 😊
netbot: [info] Local ISP "HomeFiber" scheduled micro-outage 2329994500-2329994600 UTC for maintenance. Expect brief reconnections for consumer modems.
lou: hope your backyard succulents survive the string-light audit 
iva_end: see you on the aesthetics board update :camera_with_flash:
